title: Detox Identity
description: Identity context resolved at pipeline start. Captures WHO triggered the run and WHAT repository is being targeted. Source: scripts/telemetry/identity.py. Resolution priority: CI env vars (GitLab/Jenkins/GitHub) > git config > $USER env fallback. TRANSPORT: embedded in the exported 'detox.pipeline_run' event as detox.* labels (user.name, user.email, cio, repo_name); the Barclays identity (barclays_user_id/cio/team/user_email) is additionally injected on every Observe record from OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES by plugin_observability.py.

user_name.description: Developer or CI user who triggered the pipeline. Resolution: GITLAB_USER_LOGIN > CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR > GITHUB_ACTOR > BUILD_USER > git config user.name > $USER > 'unknown'.

user_email.description: Developer email. Resolution: GITLAB_USER_EMAIL > BUILD_USER_EMAIL > git config user.email > empty string.

cio.description: Barclays CIO (barclays_cio from ~/.claude/settings.json OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, set by the mandatory user setup). Null if setup incomplete.

ci_job_id.description: CI job identifier. GitLab: CI_JOB_ID, Jenkins: BUILD_NUMBER, GitHub: GITHUB_RUN_ID. Null for local runs.

ci_pipeline_id.description: CI pipeline identifier. GitLab: CI_PIPELINE_ID, Jenkins: JOB_NAME, GitHub: GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER. Null for local runs.

ci_project_name.description: CI project name. GitLab: CI_PROJECT_NAME, GitHub: last segment of GITHUB_REPOSITORY. Only populated for CI runs.

ci_project_url.description: CI project URL. GitLab only: CI_PROJECT_URL. Null for non-GitLab CI or local runs.

hostname.description: Machine hostname where the pipeline was executed.

source.description: How identity was resolved. Indicates whether this was a CI run or local execution.

repo_name.description: Short repository name. Extracted from git remote URL (last path segment, stripped of .git), or fallback to directory name.

repo_url.description: Full git remote URL. Empty string if not in a git repo.
